Package details
This Mayer Hasi Package is
not for sale
. As CSR initiative, SIM will be provided FREE.
SIM is free of cost for eligible mothers. 60 mins talktime and 1 GB data with 15 days will be provided as start-up bonus upon Tk.29 recharge.
Existing Teletalk subscribers who are eligible for stipend can migrate to this package.
For migration subscriber needs to type MH stipend account number and send SMS to 556. (Charge free)
Migration from Mayer Hasi to other package is NOT allowed.
FnF process: For FnF type reg and send sms to 363 for registration. After successful registration type Add desired number and sms send to 363 (charge free).
VAT, SD and SC are applicable in all tariffs
